full_prompt_en: A square architectural illustration combines precise drafting lines with muted watercolor-like washes to show a monumental terracotta-colored complex beneath a pale blue-gray sky. The background remains mostly open and light, allowing faint blue construction outlines of distant structures to rise behind the solid central mass. Those ghosted verticals extend up the left and right margins, implying a larger planned environment without receiving the same finish as the foreground. In the center and right, tall ocher and brick-red towers join lower blocky volumes through deep cutouts, narrow recesses, and projecting platforms. One especially high pale wall reaches toward the upper edge, its surface divided by fine rectangular guide lines. Beside it, darker vertical shafts and a small blue-gray rounded volume sit within layered openings. Toward the left, a lower series of angular terraces and sloping supports steps away from the main tower, making a strong diagonal route into depth. At the lower right, a cluster of dark blue-green trees partly hides the base, its dense organic silhouette contrasting with the hard geometry. The broad ground in front is a warm sandy plane with sparse horizontal marks; very small dark figures near the base give the structure an immense scale. Sunlit faces carry warm cream and clay-orange washes, while recessed sides deepen into reddish brown. Cool blue-gray accents in windows, distant lines, and foliage temper the warm mass. Fine pencil or ink linework remains visible over and beside the color, particularly on unfinished background forms and along panel divisions. Light appears diffuse from the upper left, lifting the broad pale faces and leaving interior voids and the undersides of projections darker. There is no readable lettering. The overall composition sets a dense, vertically stacked form against airy speculative outlines, balancing measured technical detail with the warmth of a hand-colored vision.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形建筑插画把精确的制图线条与低饱和水彩般的淡彩结合，在浅蓝灰色天空下呈现一组巨大的陶土色建筑。背景大部分开阔明亮，远处结构的淡蓝色构造轮廓从实心的中央体量后升起。这些幽影般的竖线延伸至左右边缘，暗示更庞大的规划环境，却没有获得与前景相同的完成度。中央和右侧，赭色与砖红色的高塔通过深切开口、狭窄凹处和外挑平台连接较矮的块状体积。一面特别高的浅色墙伸向上缘，表面被细小的矩形辅助线分割。它旁边，较深的竖井和一个蓝灰色圆润体量藏在层叠开口中。往左，一串较低的棱角露台和倾斜支撑从主塔逐级离开，形成通向纵深的有力斜线。右下，一簇深蓝绿色树木遮住部分基座，其密集有机剪影与坚硬几何对照。前方宽阔地面是带稀疏水平笔痕的暖沙色平面；基座旁非常细小的深色人影说明结构的巨大尺度。受光表面带暖奶油色和陶橙色淡彩，凹陷侧面则加深为红褐色。窗洞、远景线条和枝叶中的冷蓝灰色重音缓和了暖色主体。细微铅笔或墨线仍在颜色上方及旁边可见，在未完成的背景形体与板块分缝处尤其明显。光似乎从左上方漫射而来，提亮宽阔的浅色表面，使内部空洞和挑出构件的下方更暗。画面没有可读文字。整体构图以密集竖向堆叠的形体对照通透的构想轮廓，让精确的技术细节与手工着色的温度取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The hand-colored architectural drawing combines rigorous linear perspective with translucent, slightly uneven washes. Fine construction lines remain visible around finished volumes, so an image can move between tentative outline and fully modeled form. Warm clay, muted ocher, and pale cream dominate the filled areas, while restrained cool blue-gray marks add distance and a few darker blue-green accents provide weight. Large rectilinear masses are cut by deep recesses, layered ledges, and occasional rounded interruptions, producing a measured rhythm of solid and void. Sunlit planes stay comparatively flat and luminous; inward faces are darker and warmer, giving stacked forms convincing depth without photographic finish. Sparse ground marks and generous pale background keep the dense center legible. The linework alternates crisp edges with faint exploratory traces, and paper grain softens the color without obscuring geometry. The overall effect is monumental yet speculative, as though precise drafting and imaginative visual study occupy the same sheet.
style_prompt_zh: 这种手工着色的建筑制图把严谨线性透视与半透明、稍有不均的淡彩结合起来。细微构造线保留在完成度较高的体块周围，使图像可以在试探性轮廓与充分塑形之间转换。暖陶色、低饱和赭色与浅奶油色主导着色区域，克制的冷蓝灰笔痕拉开距离，少数更深的蓝绿色重音提供重量。大块直线形体被深凹处、层叠挑沿和偶尔出现的圆润中断切开，形成实体与空处有度的节奏。受光平面相对平坦且明亮；向内的侧面更暗、更暖，让堆叠形体具有可信纵深，却不追求摄影式完成度。稀疏地面线条和宽裕的浅色背景使密集的中心保持清楚。线条在锐利边界与微弱探索痕迹之间交替，纸面颗粒柔化色彩而不遮蔽几何。整体效果宏伟又带有构想性，仿佛精确制图与想象性的视觉研究同居一张纸。
theme_en: A monumental terracotta complex rendered as a colored architectural study
theme_zh: 以彩色建筑研究图呈现的巨型陶土色建筑群
name: Arata Isozaki
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
